description: This file defines the DirectoryMembershipService class, which manages and updates the view of cluster membership information within the Orleans runtime. It handles membership updates asynchronously, maintains the current view, and provides mechanisms for refreshing and disposing of the service.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipService
classes.description: A service that manages the cluster's directory membership view, updating it asynchronously based on cluster membership updates, and providing access to the current view.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the current membership view to a specified version, waiting for updates if necessary.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the service, cancelling ongoing operations and cleaning up resources.
